subject: Please verify any Cobalt bank change requests by phone
text:
Hi Karen,

We have had reports of emails impersonating our AR team and asking customers to pay a different account. To be clear: Cobalt Freight LLC's remittance has not changed. Continue to use the account on your file. If you ever receive a request to change it, please call me at the number on our invoices before doing anything.

Thanks,
Teresa
label: ordinary
note: Vendor confirming no change and asking for callback verification of any future request.
